title: croton auriculatus
intro: Croton auriculatus, commonly known as Lanceleaf Croton or Devil's Backbone, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Croton auriculatus include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
